name: Sofa BITE - 2 Seater (Fabric, Gunmetal Grey)
description: Meet the Bite Sofa: its got serious style and super comfy seating without needing a stadium-sized living room! The elegant tufted design sits atop beautiful gold accent legs for that irresistible, luxe touch. Go ahead, sink right in! The seating is built for relaxation, featuring expertly layered 6” foam over reliable zig-zag springs. That extra depth means you have the freedom to truly stretch out or just curl up for a movie marathon. We also have great news for clumsy folks! The 380 GSM fabric is both stain and water-repellant, making it the most worry-free piece of furniture for your home. Cleaning shouldn't be a workout and those elevated legs make vacuuming underneath a breeze. Ready to make this trendy sofa the statement piece for your living room?

contentSections.heading: FAQs
contentSections.text: FAQs 1. What is Sofa Bite Sofa Bite is a 3‑seater fabric sofa from Sleepyhead, a tuxedo design with a tufted back cushions, and gold‑accent legs to create a bold, luxe‑looking statement piece for compact living rooms. 2. What are its unique features? It features a tufted back for a premium look, tuxedo design, expertly layered 6 inch foam with zig-zag spring support, supportive seating, stain and water‑repellent 380 GSM fabric, elevated gold‑accent legs that make vacuuming underneath easier, and a sturdy hardwood frame for long‑term durability. 3. Is professional installation/assembly included with Sofa Bite? Yes the professional installation is provided by Sleepyhead Experts”. 4. What are the space requirements for Sofa Bite? Sofa Bite measures 195 cm (length) × 78.7 cm (depth) × 77 cm (height), so you should allow at least 196 cm of wall length plus about 10–20 cm clearance on each side and in front for comfortable movement and to appreciate the leg design. 5. What warranty comes with Sofa Bite? Sofa Bite comes with a 3‑year conditional warranty, 6. Can I try the Sofa Bite before purchasing? Yes, you can try at a nearest Sleepyhead store. 7. Is the Sofa Bite customizable (fabric, color, configuration)? The BITE family is currently offered in multiple colours (Arrowwood Yellow, Firedbrick Red, Gunmetal Grey, etc.) and in 2‑seater and 3‑seater sizes, and we do not offer other customisation options. 8. What seating configurations are available for Sofa Bite? Sofa Bite is available as a 2‑seater and a 3‑seater standalone sofa. 9. How do I clean and maintain Sofa Bite? Clean using a soft, dry or slightly damp cloth for dust and light spills; for stains, blot (do not rub) with a mild, non‑bleach detergent solution on a damp cloth, then wipe with a clean, dry cloth. The 380 GSM stain‑ and water‑repellent fabric helps resist spills, and the elevated legs make vacuuming underneath easier, but you should avoid harsh chemicals and prolonged direct sunlight to preserve colour and foam integrity
